info.title: DeepImage Universal API
info.description: DeepImage: Enhance, upscale, and transform images

post.description: Creates an accurate business avatar in DeepImage.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: Public URL of the source face image.

background.generate.description.description: Prompt describing the desired accurate business portrait.
background.generate.description.example: A woman sitting behind a desk in a modern office environment. Her smiling face is seen from behind her computer screen, with only the top of her head and a portion of her shoulders visible. The office space around her is bright and airy, illuminated by soft, natural light streaming in from large windows.

background.generate.model_type.description: Generative model used for avatar creation.
